About this item

  • AI Facial, Pet and Gesture Recognition: Ready to experience a better smart home? Imagine your camera can recognize your face and welcome you when you come home or recognize strangers and send out notifications to warn you. You can also trigger pre-set actions with five different gestures, which is a new and unique feature that is not available in similar products of other brands.
  • 2K 1296p Resolution & 360° Viewing Angle: The Camera Hub G3 incorporates a high-resolution 2304 x 1296 pixel sensor that results in better image quality with more details.* In HomeKit Secure Video mode, the camera records in Full HD 1080p due to the current limitations of HomeKit technology. 110° wide-angle lens coupled with the Pan and Tilt motors provides up to 340° rotation angle, supports automatic cruising, and face and pet recognition. No more Blind Areas in your home.
  • Local Control Center: As a Zigbee 3.0 hub, it can connect up to 128 Aqara Zigbee child-devices (**Not third-party zigbee device) and allow for seamless integration across Aqara’s sensors and home automation devices such as home guard, data reporting and smart control. HomeKit, Alexa, Google Assistant, IFTTT are supported.Note: The IR function is not currently supported by HomeKit. Instead, you can try using Aqara Home or Google Home, as well as triggering the Aqara Home scenes via Siri Shortcuts or other voice assistants.
  • Local Infrared Control & 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi: The Camera Hub G3 has a built-in IR controller that can make your existing infrared-compatible devices smart and support local automations. All the IR automations are local and will run even if there is no internet connection. Moreover, no more worrying about network type compatibility: the Camera Hub G3 supports 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi, the most popular Wi-Fi frequencies, and uses them to connect your Aqara child devices to the network.
  • We Care About Your Privacy: The G3 Camera Hub is certified by Apple, Google, and Amazon to meet all the security standards of the system of your choice. No need to worry about privacy leakage problems. It also has a hardware privacy protection mode that can be turned on manually or automatically. This mode can be easily identified by a cute sleepy face. Moreover, the data streams from the camera are encrypted and the latest Wi-Fi security standard WPA3 is supported to further protect your data.

Product Description

hero-video

Merchant video

AI-Powered Facial and Gesture Recognition

By importing your photos, the Camera Hub G3 can trigger personalized automations when you come home. Moreover, with smart gesture recognition, smart home control has become simpler and more fun than ever!

Crystal Clear and Omni-Directional Care, Better than Ever

Via a high-resolution 2304 x 1296 pixel sensor and dynamic bit rate technology, both static and cruise images are crystal-clear. 110° wide-angle lens coupled with the Pan and Tilt motors provides up to 360° rotation angle without any blind areas.

* In HomeKit Secure Video mode, the camera records in Full HD 1080p due to the current limitations of HomeKit technology.

HomeKit Secure Video and WPA3 Are Supported, We Care About Your Privacy

* The cute head cover is detachable and added as an accessory.

* Please note: The privacy mode does not currently work with Apple Homekit, only with the Aqara Home app. An upcoming firmware release will allow Apple HomeKit to access these features.

Simple Setup, Great Value, Excellent Features
Super product. Purchased straight after buying the external G5 Pro Hub. These Aqara products are excellent value and so far the quality is very good. The resolution on this camera is a big upgrade on my previous Logitech. Setup and smart home integration (in my case Apple HomeKit) was really very easy and I had this working within less than 10 minutes. It is very feature rich with a number of ways for recording video. I’m still scratching the surface albeit have set this up with HomeKit recording already. I spent a bit of time researching manufacturers as I like to be within the same ecosystem so far I’m glad I was patient and waited to invest in these Aqara items.

Yes alarm The aqara products works well together to make daily tasks simple. With one press of the Aqara wifi button can set multiple things to occurr. eg. Turn off privacy mode protection and deactivate facial recognition which has been set to turn off camera if recognised preset faces.     5 out of 5 stars
    🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Fantastic All-in-One Smart Camera Hub!
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 5 July 2025
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I’ve been using the Aqara G3 for a few weeks now and I’m genuinely impressed. It’s not just a camera—it’s a smart home hub, an AI assistant, and a remote control all in one neat, compact unit.

    Camera Quality: The 2K resolution is super crisp, even in low light. The night vision is clear, and the pan/tilt functionality means I can cover an entire room remotely through the app. It’s very responsive and smooth.

    Smart Features: The built-in AI is surprisingly accurate—facial recognition works well for familiar faces, and the gesture control is a fun and unique addition (great for quick commands when your hands are full). The motion detection is smart enough to ignore pets most of the time, which is a big plus.

    HomeKit Secure Video: Set-up with Apple HomeKit was seamless, and I love that it supports HSV. It’s reassuring to know video footage is end-to-end encrypted and stored in iCloud.

    Compatibility: Works flawlessly with Alexa and Google Assistant too (I tested both), and you can integrate it with IFTTT for some pretty clever automations.

    IR Remote Function: A really underrated feature! I’ve managed to control my TV and aircon directly through the G3, replacing some of the clutter on my coffee table.

    Zigbee Hub: If you’re in the Aqara ecosystem or looking to get started with smart sensors, this doubles as a Zigbee hub. I’ve connected door and motion sensors without needing another device—super convenient.

    UK Plug Version: This model came with a UK plug, no need for adapters. Small detail, but important!

    Overall: Highly recommend if you’re looking for a reliable smart indoor camera with loads of features. It’s a bit of an investment, but considering what it offers, I think it’s excellent value for money.

    Setup was relatively straight forward. Once in place however, wifi connection seemed a bit spotty in a mid-sized semi-detached with good networking gear. Loadspeed particularly on Homekit was very slow - Google Home and Alexa was okay but was perceptible lag.

    Main draw for me is the future-proofing/manufacturer-proofing integrations with Google Home, Alexa and Homekit was okay - but limitations of each protocol meant different functions in each home-ecosystem which led to a bit of confusion. Specifically bought this for Homekit integration, so was slightly disappointed when I had to use the Aqara app for a lot of the functions, because I dislike the idea of being embedded into one manufacturer. Hopefully standardisation in the smarthome industry eg Matter will improve things in the future.

    Build quality was good - nothing to write home about. But very much enjoyed the automatic privacy shutter of the camera - and gestures were good. However, not stand out features that make this a must have. Hub feature is also good, but can't take advantage of that currently.

    Camera quality was a little bit worse than expected, but at this price I think it is fair.

    Eventually after getting frustrated in setting this up, I returned this and ended up paying more for an Arlo Pro 4. Looking forward to a sequel product which hopefully polishes up the integrations and the speeds.

    This camera has far exceeded my expectations. It works seamlessly with HomeKit which is a massive bonus. The Aqara app allows a lot of functions for this camera. I bought this camera to keep an eye on my dog when she’s alone on some occasions. The camera has the option to turn it off so it’s not constantly looking at you, the actual camera rolls back into itself so you have piece of mind that it is in fact off. The ability to use your phone to talk through the camera is brilliant and the audio quality is surprisingly clear and loud. If you insert a micro SD card into the camera this allows for recording whenever the camera is active. It’s really easy to look through the timeline and record specific video from the timeline and save to your phone with ease. The camera quality through the Aqara app is great and the options for the recording and motion in HomeKit is great. The night vision is also exceptional. Overall, this is an exceptionally good camera with many features and capabilities. I highly recommend this indoor camera.

    1 out of 5 stars
    Not reliable
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 30 September 2024
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I got this when I decided to adopt a second cat, so that I could use it to monitor whichever cat was in the base camp room. Since moving to integration I have used it to monitor behaviour when I am not around and to provide insights into the way my cats respond to things.

    Pros: image quality is great, it detects movement and sound well and records clip for later review. The notifications are great and the feature to trigger automation from a sign at the camera is useful as I also have the blinds and can open or close them from my bed using the camera.

    Cons: the recordings are only for 12 seconds which catches most things but if you're hoping for a significant amount of data you won't get it. But more importantly it is constantly disconnecting! I have unfortunately had an incident where one cat became aggressive towards the other and myself so thru are now separated whilst they get vet exams etc. I was reliant on the camera to monitor them and know where in the room they are before I walk in, don't exactly want to run over any paws and be on the receiving end of another cat frenzy but it just keeps disconnecting. I have gone in and reconnected the camera at 2pm and the screenshot is what I'm met with now.

    My Internet is fine, it is strong all the waycthrough the flat so that is not an excuse they can use and I can see from other reviewers they've experienced the same issue. Honestly, despite all the features this issue makes having the camera totally pointless. A total waste of money and I'll have to get something from elsewhere.

About this Item

  • AI Facial, Pet and Gesture Recognition: Ready to experience a better smart home? Imagine your camera can recognize your face and welcome you when you come home or recognize strangers and send out notifications to warn you. You can also trigger pre-set actions with five different gestures, which is a new and unique feature that is not available in similar products of other brands.
  • 2K 1296p Resolution & 360° Viewing Angle: The Camera Hub G3 incorporates a high-resolution 2304 x 1296 pixel sensor that results in better image quality with more details.* In HomeKit Secure Video mode, the camera records in Full HD 1080p due to the current limitations of HomeKit technology. 110° wide-angle lens coupled with the Pan and Tilt motors provides up to 340° rotation angle, supports automatic cruising, and face and pet recognition. No more Blind Areas in your home.
  • Local Control Center: As a Zigbee 3.0 hub, it can connect up to 128 Aqara Zigbee child-devices (**Not third-party zigbee device) and allow for seamless integration across Aqara’s sensors and home automation devices such as home guard, data reporting and smart control. HomeKit, Alexa, Google Assistant, IFTTT are supported.Note: The IR function is not currently supported by HomeKit. Instead, you can try using Aqara Home or Google Home, as well as triggering the Aqara Home scenes via Siri Shortcuts or other voice assistants.
  • Local Infrared Control & 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi: The Camera Hub G3 has a built-in IR controller that can make your existing infrared-compatible devices smart and support local automations. All the IR automations are local and will run even if there is no internet connection. Moreover, no more worrying about network type compatibility: the Camera Hub G3 supports 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi, the most popular Wi-Fi frequencies, and uses them to connect your Aqara child devices to the network.
  • We Care About Your Privacy: The G3 Camera Hub is certified by Apple, Google, and Amazon to meet all the security standards of the system of your choice. No need to worry about privacy leakage problems. It also has a hardware privacy protection mode that can be turned on manually or automatically. This mode can be easily identified by a cute sleepy face. Moreover, the data streams from the camera are encrypted and the latest Wi-Fi security standard WPA3 is supported to further protect your data.
